notes.title: Update: Rebuilt on Steam
notes.notes:
It's reported that the game wouldn't start for some players (who used to be able to play), therefore the contents are uploaded again.
Nothing is changed about the game itself. 

If you have the problem of words/icons missing from any menu (like it in Airi's Adventure), try using the Vista Compatibility mode: please find your local game folder, right click on "game.exe", and choose Properties >> Vista compatibility mode.

The Light version is still okay and unchanged.

Sorry about the troubles, m(_ _)m
Thanks for reading!

notes.title: New version update and Savedata
notes.notes:
The New version is updated now! 
In the new version:
+ Lnaguages can be changed in the game.
+ Thai localization added! (Thanks to the hard work of [url=https://www.facebook.com/whateverzonepage]Whateverzone[/url]!)
+ A new outfit unlocked for the second run (just like in T&T!)

However, I'm not sure about its performance on PCs after building it on Steam...I'm aware that the 1.0 version was laggy in large and dark maps. If this version is not any better (or even worse) I'll definitely change it back.*panicking*

Meanwhile I'm setting up the Light Version as a free DLC so that if any of you have problem running or starting the game, you can download it to play the game, though it won't have Steam features [strike]because the achievements are mainly the reason why it acts so terriblily[/strike].

If you see a "no header" bug, it's random and comes from nowhere...it may happen when your PC doesn't run very smoothly. For now please [b]save the game frequently[/b]!

I'm really sorry about the inconvenience. orz

[h1]How to Use 2nd Run Savedata[/h1]
+ The savedata is included in your [b]local game folder[/b].
+ Copy the files in "2nd Run Save" folder, and paste them into "save" in "www" folder, and run the game.
+ Click "New Game" to play.

Thanks again for all the support and understanding!
*weeping in exhaustion*

notes.title: The upcoming update (affect save data!) and OTHER NEWS☆
notes.notes:
[h1]☆Update[/h1]
As planned, TWTP will have a v2.0 in June (possiblily next week).
The game's system has been changed therefore the old save data cannot be used in the new version! Please [b]TURN OFF the Steam auto-update[/b] to avoid losing your progress.

In the new version:
+ Lnaguages can be changed in the game.
+ Thai localization added! (Thanks to the hard work of [url=https://www.facebook.com/whateverzonepage]Whateverzone[/url]!)
+ A new outfit unlocked for the second run (just like in T&T!)

It's a known issue that there is lagging in the dark maps in chapter 2 & 3. It's due to the engine and its steam build, and the problems may happen depending on various PCs, which is a problem that I currently cannot solve...
You may want to purchase the Light version without the steam features on [url=https://rabbitongames.itch.io/twtp-light] itch.io [/url], which should have a better performance.

A "second-run" data will be provided with the game for those who played and wish to have a second run quickly.
There's no new content in the second run except the outfit [strike]but I hope you can enjoy it anyway[/strike].


[h1]☆ Hello Charlotte[/h1]
I'm honored to have the chance to translate the amazing games of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/557630/Hello_Charlotte_EP2_Requiem_Aeternam_Deo/] Hello Charlotte [/url]into Chinese! 
The Chinese version of EP2 will be released soon, and EP1 is already for downloading on the [url=http://hellocharlotte.lofter.com/] CN blog [/url]. 
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29675996/1a32c0cac968bf9fbf87a4bbb2f536f8db94c724.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29675996/1e586048d0eedad547319e9e90f684d81378495e.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]☆ The New Project: Airi's Adventure[/h1]
The new RPG in development is also going to have a demo soon. The development is basically done yet the translation and testing will still take some time (hopefully in the end of June [strike]though I'm not very confident with my schedule...[/strike]).
It's a very casual (and traditional) turn-based JRPG.
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29675996/5cde16825fa01a5ceec32339127a76cba06e1791.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29675996/f667cef3b5efdacc359ffa251d38f14e96d0cbae.png[/img][/url] 
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29675996/ead731f21710606bc2bb0054b23da3cd23ad46ea.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29675996/85a804597fcd81eb1b573629c790a732cf60b8e6.png[/img][/url]
If you're interested please check [url=ameliaandfriends.tumblr.com] the dev blog [/url] for more infomation : )
Or follow on [url=https://twitter.com/RabbitonBooks] Twitter [/url]! :D

Thanks again for all the support!

notes.title: A light version released on Itch.io, future update (affect save data!) and a new project
notes.notes:
☆Light version

This new "light" version of TWTP is built without the Steam features, which should have a better performance, or at least be able to run properly.
If you had problems running the game and are still interested in getting it (I appreciate it very much), or if you simply prefer to purchase it elsewhere, or purchase the DLC without the game...here is another choice on [url=https://rabbitongames.itch.io/] itch.io[/url].

It now has 25% off, and a witch bundle for all the 4 items.
Sale goes on until 5th May.
(If you're not satisfied with it on Steam I do hope you still have the chance to get a refund...Really sorry about that, again; v; )


☆Future Update (that affect the save data!)

This new version is also an updated version that adds a new outfit for the second run, and the languages can be changed inside the game.
Its Steam version will be updated here too, when the ongoing Spanish and Thai localizations are finished!

But please note that the old version’s save data CANNOT be transfered to the updated version, due to the change of the system. Therefore I suggest that, 
1) firstly TURN OFF the auto-update on Steam, 
2) then you can either finish the game, OR
3) wait until it’s updated to play the new version. 

I’m planning to include a “game finished” save date for the players to start the second run quickly, if they'd like to.
Apologize one more time for all the inconvenience...m(_ _)m


☆ The New Project
There's a new RPG currently in development, hopefully a demo in this summer.
If you're interested please check the [url=https://ameliaandfriends.tumblr.com/]dev blog[/url] for more infomation : )

Thanks again for all the support.
